description: This file contains the implementation of AzureBasedMembershipTable class which manages membership data for Orleans Silo clusters using Azure Table Storage. It provides methods for initializing the table, reading, inserting, updating, and deleting silo membership entries, and handles parsing and conversion between storage entries and in-memory representations.

classes.name: AzureBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements IMembershipTable interface to manage cluster membership information using Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, creates the table version row if required.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a given cluster.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries of silos that are no longer active before a specified date.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific silo entry from the table by its SiloAddress.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo entries from the membership table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry into the table conditionally based on version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry, conditionally on etag.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific membership entry.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a list of table entries into MembershipTableData.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a table entry into a MembershipEntry object.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry into a table entry for storage.

methods.name: ConvertPartial
methods.description: Creates a partial table entry with only IAmAliveTime info.
